lines.en:
Guess they're keepin' this place as a memorial.  World's got just about enough of 'em.  Ain't no medal gonna bring these boys back...
Brave young ones...  yer the best among us.  Donar bless 'em, each and every one...
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en: Protagonist...  I ain't got much left in me, but I reckon you do.  Don't waste this...  you know how it goes with war...  you can fix it.
lines.zh: Protagonist…… 我已经时日无多了，但你应该还能活很久。 不要浪费时光…… 你懂得战争的后果…… 你能解决它的。
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯
